description: AWS Cost Explorer LINKED_ACCOUNT unblended spend for the last N days vs the $77k MTD budget and $3k daily SLO ceiling. Use for total AWS spend, budget %, or daily run-rate. Not CUR.

configuration.query:
FROM metrics-aws.billing-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - TO_DATEPERIOD(CONCAT(TO_STRING(?days), " days"))
    AND aws.billing.group_definition.key == "LINKED_ACCOUNT"
| STATS total_spend = SUM(aws.billing.UnblendedCost.amount)
| EVAL lookback_days = ?days::integer
| EVAL avg_daily = total_spend / lookback_days
| EVAL monthly_budget_usd = 77000
| EVAL daily_slo_ceiling_usd = 3000
| EVAL pct_of_mtd_budget = total_spend / monthly_budget_usd * 100

days.description: Lookback window in days (30 for MTD-like, 7 for recent trend)
